name: Barrier Income ETF
description: Sells "barrier" put options with a pre-set 30% downside threshold on a mix of US large-cap, small-cap, and growth stocks to generate high monthly income, while also holding short-duration Treasuries — the loss point is defined upfront rather than open-ended like a typical options-income fund.

name: Managed Futures Strategy ETF
description: Actively managed trend-following strategy that goes long or short across equity, interest-rate, currency, and commodity futures — designed to post positive returns independent of stock market direction, including during equity sell-offs.

name: Aggregate Bond ETF
description: Core investment-grade bond exposure similar in risk to the broad U.S. Aggregate Bond index, enhanced with options-selling and yield-curve positioning to target higher income and total return than a plain bond index fund.

name: Currency Strategy ETF
description: Actively trades foreign currencies: a "carry" strategy going long high-interest-rate emerging-market currencies and short low-interest-rate ones, paired with a mean-reversion strategy on G10 currencies — aiming for returns largely uncorrelated to stocks and bonds.

name: Target 15 Distribution ETF
description: Sells barrier put options on major equity indices, adjusting the barrier level as needed to pursue an aspirational 15% annualized monthly distribution rate — a more aggressive, flexible version of Simplify's barrier-income approach, paired with US government securities for stability.

name: Hedged Equity ETF
description: Holds full S&P 500 exposure while layering a rolling "put-spread collar" — buying downside protection and selling some upside — across three staggered 3-month cycles, aiming to smooth out volatility and cap losses in exchange for limiting gains during rallies.

name: Government Money Market ETF
description: A true government money-market fund in ETF form: holds cash, short-term U.S. government securities, and repurchase agreements for stability and current income. Unlike most money-market funds, its share price floats slightly rather than staying pinned at a fixed value.

name: MBS ETF
description: Invests in newer, higher-coupon agency mortgage-backed securities (issued by Ginnie Mae, Fannie Mae, and Freddie Mac) via TBA forward contracts, targeting better yield than a standard MBS index fund with minimal added credit risk versus Treasuries.

name: Short Term Treasury Futures Strategy ETF
type: Short Term Treasury Futures Strategy ETF
description: Uses leveraged 2-year Treasury futures to replicate the interest-rate sensitivity (duration) of the 7-10 year Treasury index while tying up less capital — a capital-efficient way to add intermediate-duration bond exposure, or a building block for risk-parity-style portfolios.

name: Volatility Premium ETF
description: Holds a modest short position (roughly -0.2x to -0.3x) in VIX futures to harvest the volatility risk premium as income, while buying VIX call options as a hedge against sudden volatility spikes — aims to profit in calm markets while limiting damage during shocks.

name: Treasury Option Income ETF
description: Holds short-duration (1-year or less) U.S. Treasury securities for stable interest income, layered with an options-writing strategy on equity and bond ETFs for extra yield — targets money-market-like stability without being an actual money market fund.

name: Health Care ETF
description: Actively managed portfolio of roughly 50–100 U.S. healthcare and biotech stocks seeking long-term growth — and donates 100% of Simplify's net management-fee profits from the fund to the Susan G. Komen breast cancer foundation.

name: High Yield ETF
description: Core high-yield ("junk") bond exposure paired with a flexible credit hedge — primarily a "Quality-minus-Junk" factor position, supplemented opportunistically with credit default swaps or equity puts — designed to capture high-yield income while cushioning against a sudden widening in credit spreads.

name: US Equity Income ETF
description: Combines U.S. large-cap equity exposure with both long and short call options (rather than a standard covered call) to generate tax-efficient monthly income while retaining more upside participation than typical covered-call income funds.

name: Interest Rate Hedge ETF
description: Holds long-dated options on 20-year Treasury bonds (via interest-rate swaptions) designed to rise sharply in value when long-term interest rates spike or bond-market volatility increases — a direct hedge against rising rates rather than a bet on falling ones.

name: Kayne Anderson Energy & Infrastructure Credit ETF
type: Kayne Anderson Energy and Infrastructure Credit ETF
description: Actively managed by energy-investing specialist Kayne Anderson, this fund buys bonds, loans, and other credit instruments issued by energy and infrastructure companies for higher income than a typical high-yield bond fund at comparatively higher credit quality.

name: US Equity PLUS Managed Futures Strategy ETF
type: US Equity PLUS Managed Futures Strategy ETF
description: Delivers 100% notional exposure to both U.S. large-cap stocks and a systematic long/short managed-futures strategy (via a swap on Simplify's own CTA fund) from a single investment — a capital-efficient way to add managed-futures diversification without cutting your existing stock allocation.

name: US Equity PLUS Convexity ETF
description: Core low-cost S&P 500 exposure plus a modest options overlay (buying both puts and calls) designed to add extra gains during sharp market moves in either direction — a small, ongoing "insurance premium" cost in calm markets in exchange for a boost during volatility spikes.

name: US Equity PLUS Downside Convexity ETF
type: US Equity PLUS Downside Convexity ETF
description: Core low-cost S&P 500 exposure plus a modest put-option overlay designed specifically to cushion losses during sharp market sell-offs, without capping upside participation in rallies — essentially downside insurance layered onto a standard large-cap holding.

name: Chinese Commodities Strategy No K-1 ETF
type: Chinese Commodities Strategy No K-1 ETF
description: Systematic long/short strategy trading commodity futures on major Chinese exchanges (Shanghai, Dalian, Zhengzhou) — markets largely inaccessible to U.S. investors directly — via a structure that avoids issuing the K-1 tax form typical of commodity funds.

name: Commodities Strategy No K-1 ETF
description: Systematic long/short strategy trading global commodity futures (energy, metals, agriculture) built by the same managers as CCOM, but focused on broad international commodity markets rather than China-specific ones — also structured to avoid issuing a K-1 tax form.

name: Propel Opportunities ETF
description: Actively managed portfolio of biotech, pharma, health-tech, and life-science companies that sub-advisor Propel believes are overlooked by mainstream investors — a higher-conviction, higher-cost stock-picking approach within a single sector rather than a broad healthcare index.

name: Enhanced Income ETF
description: Holds short-term Treasuries for baseline income, then sells short-dated put and call spreads on global equity indices to add extra monthly income — designed as an alternative to high-yield bonds with less exposure to credit and interest-rate risk.

name: Intermediate Term Treasury Futures Strategy ETF
type: Intermediate Term Treasury Futures Strategy ETF
description: Uses 10-year Treasury futures to replicate the interest-rate sensitivity (duration) of the longer 20+ year Treasury index while committing less capital — a capital-efficient way to add long-duration bond exposure, particularly useful in risk-parity-style portfolios.

name: Ancorato Target 25 Distribution ETF
description: Sells barrier put options on individual stocks (or baskets of stocks), continually adjusting the barrier level, to pursue an aspirational 25% annualized monthly distribution — Simplify's highest-target, most aggressive fund in its barrier-income lineup, sub-advised by Ancorato Capital.

name: National Muni Bond ETF
description: Actively managed municipal bond portfolio seeking tax-free income from undervalued munis overlooked by passive index funds, layered with an options-selling strategy across equity, fixed-income, and commodity instruments for extra (taxable) yield on top of the tax-free coupon income.

name: Bond Bull ETF
description: The mirror image of Simplify's PFIX: holds long-dated options (a receiver swaption) structured to behave like a call option on long-term Treasury bonds, designed to rise sharply in value when long-term interest rates fall or bond-market volatility spikes.

name: US Equity PLUS Bitcoin Strategy ETF
type: US Equity PLUS Bitcoin Strategy ETF
description: Targets 100% U.S. large-cap equity exposure plus roughly 10% Bitcoin exposure (via Bitcoin ETFs), with the Bitcoin sleeve actively rebalanced to stay near that target — a simpler way to add a modest, capped Bitcoin allocation on top of a core equity holding without managing it yourself.

name: Gamma Emerging Market Bond ETF
description: Actively managed emerging-market bond fund focused primarily on Latin American issuers, using fundamental economic and political research to select sovereign and corporate debt — aiming for yields comparable to or above U.S. high-yield bonds with added geographic diversification.

name: NEXT Intangible Core Index ETF
description: Passively tracks an index of roughly 200 U.S. companies with high "intangible capital" (patents, brand value, software, R&D) relative to their physical book assets — a rules-based tilt toward asset-light, IP-driven businesses rather than a traditional market-cap-weighted index.

name: DBi CTA Managed Futures Index ETF
type: DBi CTA Managed Futures Index ETF
description: Rules-based index fund replicating the aggregate positioning of the largest managed-futures hedge funds across 10 liquid futures markets (rates, currencies, equities, commodities), rebalanced weekly — a lower-cost, transparent alternative to Simplify's actively managed CTA fund for similar broad managed-futures exposure.

name: Opportunistic Income ETF
description: Actively managed, opportunistic credit fund investing across high-yield, investment-grade, and distressed debt, combining macro, quantitative, and fundamental research to find mispriced bonds — closer to a hedge-fund-style credit strategy than a passive bond index fund.

name: Multi-QIS Alternative ETF
description: Bundles 10–20 different institutional-grade quantitative trading strategies (across equities, rates, commodities, and currencies, sourced from major investment banks) into one fund, aiming for returns uncorrelated to stocks and bonds — a diversified "basket of hedge fund strategies" rather than a single-strategy alternative fund.

name: Gold Strategy ETF
description: Combines roughly 150% notional exposure to gold (via futures) with an options-selling strategy across equity, bond, and currency markets — designed to amplify gold's moves while adding income that a plain gold ETF doesn't provide.

name: Bitcoin Strategy ETF
description: Combines Bitcoin exposure (roughly 50%–200% of assets, sized by a proprietary technical model, via futures and ETFs rather than holding Bitcoin directly) with an options-selling income strategy — for investors who want a leveraged, income-generating Bitcoin position rather than a plain 1x Bitcoin ETF.

name: Volt TSLA Revolution ETF
description: Dynamically adjusts exposure to Tesla stock (80%–150%, via stock, options, and swaps) based on a proprietary momentum and AI-driven sentiment algorithm, with an options overlay to manage downside — a single-stock, actively-timed bet rather than a diversified EV or tech fund.

name: China A Shares PLUS Income ETF
type: China A Shares PLUS Income ETF
description: Gains exposure to mainland China "A-share" stocks (normally hard for foreign investors to access) via total return swaps rather than holding the shares directly — a structure designed to avoid capital being locked up if geopolitical tensions restrict direct China holdings — plus an options-selling overlay for extra income.

name: Piper Sandler US Small-Cap PLUS Income ETF
type: Piper Sandler US Small-Cap PLUS Income ETF
description: Actively managed small-cap U.S. stock portfolio built by sub-advisor Piper Sandler's macro-driven factor model (weighting value, profitability, and other factors based on where we are in the economic cycle), layered with an options-selling strategy for added monthly income beyond a typical small-cap fund.

name: Tara India Opportunities ETF
description: Actively managed Indian equities portfolio, sub-advised by India specialist System Two Advisors, aiming to outperform the MSCI India Index through active stock selection rather than passively tracking a broad India index.

name: Tax Aware Diversified Income Strategy ETF
type: Tax Aware Diversified Income Strategy ETF
description: A multi-strategy income fund that gains exposure to several of Simplify's other income strategies (bonds, options-selling, equity income, currency income) via swaps, deliberately designed to minimize regular taxable distributions so investors control when they realize income — built for taxable accounts.

name: VettaFi Private Credit Strategy ETF
description: Tracks an index of business development companies (BDCs) and closed-end funds focused on private credit — yields aimed at beating traditional high-yield bonds — paired with a "quality-minus-junk" credit hedge designed to cushion the fund during credit market stress.

name: Tax Aware Alternatives ETF
description: A multi-strategy alternatives fund that gains exposure to several of Simplify's other alternative strategies (managed futures, commodities, currencies, hedging) via swaps rather than holding them individually — designed to diversify a traditional stock/bond portfolio with less tax drag than holding each strategy separately.
